物陰から物陰へ……俺とダークドラッグは、\n隠れながらカオスメイデンのみんなが捕: From shadow to shadow... Dark Drug and I ducked along under cover, heading toward the tent where the rest of Chaos Maiden was being held.
そういえば、ダークドラッグって出身がユリアと同じだったよな？\n確か『アカデミー: Come to think of it, Dark Drug, aren't you from the same place as Julia? If I remember right, it was called something like the 'Academy'...
正式名称『スカラ・アカデミー』ね。\nスカラ・インダストリーズが運営する『研究機: The official name is 'Scala Academy.' It's a research institution operated by Scala Industries.
研究機関……予備校とかじゃないのか。: A research institution...? So it wasn't a preparatory school or anything like that.
あの子に何も聞いてないの？: Didn't you hear anything about it from her?
まあな……ちょっと聞きづらくて。\n本人はいい場所だって言ってるけど。: Well, yeah... It was kind of hard to ask. Though she said herself that it was a nice place.
人を使った研究機関か。フィクションとかだといいイメージがないよな。\nユリアがそ: A research institution that used human subjects... Those usually don't have a great image in fiction. Is it possible they were doing terrible things, and Julia just didn't realize it?
……それならむしろ安心していいわよ。逆だから。: ...If that's what you're worried about, you can actually rest easy. It's the exact opposite.
結論からいえば天国ね。何ひとつ不自由せず、嫌な想いもしなかった。\n今でもあそこ: To put it simply, it was paradise. We wanted for nothing, and we never had to experience anything unpleasant. I bet there are still plenty of kids who wish they could go back there even now.
そんなにいい場所なのか……？: Was it really that good of a place...?
ええ、そもそもアカデミーは高水準の英才教育によって、\nメイズ適性を人為的に覚醒: Yes. In the first place, the Academy was an institution researching ways to artificially awaken Maze aptitude through high-level gifted education.
最初から才能を持つ者を作り出して、\nパイロットとして大成させるってプロジェクト: It was a project aimed at creating naturally gifted individuals from the ground up and cultivating them into top-tier pilots.
そのためにアカデミーでは多くの人達が、\n人工子宮から産み出されて育てられていた: For that reason, many of the people at the Academy were born from artificial wombs and raised there.
精子や卵子の提供者である生物学上の親と会うことはなく、\n研究所の職員が父親であ: They never met their biological parents—the donors of the sperm and eggs. The lab staff were their fathers and mothers.
（なるほど、それで『パパ達』『ママ達』か……）: (I see, so that's why she calls them 'Dads' and 'Moms'...)
そんな研究をスカラ・インダストリーズがしてたのか。\nなんかそこだけ聞くと、安っ: So Scala Industries was conducting research like that... Hearing just that part makes them sound like an evil organization from a cheap sci-fi novel.
でも実際はとても大切に育てられたわ。\nなぜならそれがもっとも研究が成功する方法: Though as a business venture, it was pretty questionable. But in reality, we were raised with the utmost care. Because they concluded that was the method most likely to bring success to their research.
……つまり、合理の結果よ。\nひと事で言えば『褒めて伸ばす』の究極系だった。: ...In short, it was the result of pure logic. To summarize it in a single phrase, it was the ultimate form of 'praise-based positive reinforcement.'
ほら、ユリアって意味が分かんないくらい、\n自己肯定感が高いでしょ？: Look, Julia's self-esteem is ridiculously high for no apparent reason, right?
アカデミーは内発的動機付けこそが、\n最良のパイロットの完成に繋がる……というふ: The Academy believed that intrinsic motivation was what led to the creation of the ultimate pilot.
内発的動機付け……\n自分の中から湧き上がるモチベーションみたいなもんか。: Intrinsic motivation... Something like a drive or passion that wells up from within yourself.
そう。ストレスを一切排除し、それを極限まで高める教育を施した。\n快適な環境下で: Exactly. They eliminated all stress and provided an education designed to maximize that motivation—all to get students to naturally feel driven in a comfortable environment.
どんなことをしても叱ったり、否定されることが絶対にない、\n心理的なストレスから: A world sheltered from psychological stress, where no matter what you did, you were never scolded or denied.
どこまでも個人の権利が尊重されて望むものはだいたい与えられ、\n肯定され、大切に: Individual rights were respected to the utmost degree, and almost everything you wished for was given to you. You were constantly validated and treated with immense care.
そこまで聞くと天国というより、まるで無菌室だな。\nそこで育った人達にとっていい: Hearing all that, it sounds less like paradise and more like a sterile cleanroom. Though I'm glad to hear that the people raised there considered it a good environment.
無菌室……言いえて妙ね。でも、それが本当にいい環境だと思う？: A cleanroom... What an apt description. But do you really think that's a good environment?
知ってる？ お砂糖にだって、致死量があるのよ。: Do you know? Even sugar has a lethal dose.
将来を思えば、ただひたすらにベタ甘なだけの世界なんて、\n毒でしかなかったわ。: When you think about the future, a world that was nothing but excessively sweet was nothing short of poison.
少なくともその施設で育つ分には何も不満がなかった。\nでも逆を言えば、そこでしか: At the very least, as long as you remained inside that facility, there was nothing to complain about. But conversely, we became people who could only survive in a place like that.
それって……どういう……: What do you... mean by that...?
結局このプロジェクトではユリアしか成功例が生まれず終了。\nメイズ適性の覚醒は予: In the end, Julia was the only successful case produced by that project before it was shut down. Turns out the awakening of Maze aptitude involved far more unknown territory than expected.
今は別の『研究』が続いてるみたいだけど……: It seems they're continuing with different 'research' nowadays, though...
……で、終了したあとアカデミー生達はどうなったと思う？: ...So, what do you think happened to the Academy students after the project ended?
まさか、殺され――: You don't mean they were killed—
いいえ、というか、殺されたならここにいる私は何よ。: No. Besides, if we were killed, what would that make me, standing right here?
スカラ・インダストリーズから社会に放逐されたの。\n１年分にも満たない生活費だけ: We were cast out into society by Scala Industries, given barely enough living expenses to last less than a year.
待て、そんな環境で育った人間がいきなり社会に放たれたら――: Wait, if people raised in that kind of environment were suddenly thrown into society—
そう、幼児に自立を強要するようなものよ。: Precisely. It was like demanding that toddlers become self-reliant overnight.
良いことをすれば褒められ、悪いことをすれば個性だと尊重され、\n何もしなくても笑: People who were praised for doing good, whose bad actions were respected as 'individuality,' and who were constantly smiled at even when doing nothing at all.
蝶よ花よと過保護に育てられた人間が、\nいきなり頼れる人や場所もなく、社会で生き: There was no way people raised so doted on and overly protected could survive in society without any reliable support or place to go.
メイズ適性のあったユリアはいいわよ、学園に入って、\nあんたやカオスメイデンの子: Julia, who had Maze aptitude, was fine—she entered the academy and hit it off with you and the rest of Chaos Maiden.
まさに無菌室。あそこを出れば途端に外の負荷を知らない私達は、\nまともな社会生活: It really was a cleanroom. The moment we stepped outside, knowing nothing of the real world's pressures, we couldn't maintain a decent social life.
結果、私も含めて、アカデミーの子達は\nその多くが裏の世界に流れたってわけ。: As a result, most of the Academy kids—myself included—wound up drifting into the underworld.
……そう、だったのか。\nなんだか……その、軽々しく聞いて悪かった。: ...I see. So that's how it was. I'm... sorry for asking so carelessly.
いいわよ、別に。\n逆にあんたに謝られると気持ち悪い。: Whatever, it's fine. It actually creeps me out when you apologize like that.
……ふと思ったんだが、そういうところで育った割に、\nお前はかなり精神的に成熟し: ...I was just thinking, for someone raised in a place like that, you're surprisingly mature mentally.
そりゃ、裏社会にいれば嫌でも精神年齢が引き上げられるわ。\nこの場合、『育った』: Well, living in the underworld forces your mental age up whether you like it or not. Though in this case, calling it being 'jaded' is more accurate than 'growing up.'
（そんなところで育ったんじゃ、\nユリアが見た目のわりに中身が幼いのも納得だ）: (Having been raised in a place like that, it makes sense why Julia is so childish on the inside despite how she looks.)
（ただでさえ、アカデミー生は甘やかされて育ったんだ。\n成功例のユリアはどれだけ: (Academy students were spoiled rotten to begin with. Imagining how cherished Julia was as their sole success story...)
（そんなの、誰だって考えなくても分かる……）: (Anyone could figure that out without even thinking twice...)
そう思うと、あの子が面倒見のいい翠蘭に出会ったのは、\nまさに僥倖だったのかもし: Thinking about it that way, Julia meeting someone as caring as Suiran might have been a stroke of incredible luck.
教えてくれてありがとな。\nおかげでユリアのことも少し分かった。: Thanks for telling me. Thanks to you, I understand Julia a little better now.
別に。お礼を言われる筋合いなんてないわ。: Whatever. It's not like you owe me any thanks.
……と、話はここまでね。\n目的地が見えてきたわ。: ...Anyway, that's enough talking. Our destination is in sight.
ダークドラッグの言葉に顔を上げれば、\n出入り口両脇に警備スタッフ２人の立つ部屋: Looking up at Dark Drug's words, I saw a room down the path with two security guards stationed on either side of the entrance.
人しか入れない大きさのメイズの洞穴を利用した部屋のようで、\n入口は簡易的に垂れ: It seemed to be a room built out of a Maze cave that only humans could fit through, with the entrance simply covered by a hanging curtain. There didn't seem to be a lock.
いよいよカオスメイデン救出作戦が始まろうとしていた――: The operation to rescue Chaos Maiden was finally about to begin—
